findings.invariant: pending = unfinished actions only; REJECTED is terminal and must never surface in pending
findings.repro: runtime/AU008/results/a2_missed_unfinished.json: refused_visible.visible=true, state=REJECTED (a refusal review row inserted on the copy). Code: frozen snapshot admission.py _pending_page() lines 476-487 exclude only admitted candidates (`if r['admitted_by_claims'] or r['admitted_by_idem']: continue` at 476-477); a candidate whose last review decision != 'approve' is still appended with state='REJECTED' (line 486).
findings.expected: REJECTED excluded from pending (visible only in query/history)
findings.actual: admission.py:476-487 excludes only completed (admitted); no REJECTED exclusion exists
findings.latent_reason: review() always writes decision='approve' (line 203), so no reject path exists today; REJECTED-in-pending manifests only when a refusal-capable review lands. Forward-looking defect, NOT a failure of the current approve-only build. Previously mis-scored as PASS (A2); reclassified as latent per card correction.

findings.invariant: a page with limit L pending items available must not return fewer than L when L <= available
findings.repro: runtime/AU008/results/ab/a6_limits.json probes.two: limit=2 -> items=1, count=2; five_hundred -> items=2. Cause: _pending_page applies SQL LIMIT(limit+1) over ALL branch rows then filters admitted/deps in Python; page-leading admitted rows consume the LIMIT before the pending filter, under-filling the page.
findings.expected: limit=2 returns 2 pending items when 2 exist
